stem: How would the U.S. Department of Transportation’s approval of the V4 help Jonny meet his goal?

options.label: F
options.text: It would allow many school buses to use Jonny’s design, which would save energy.

options.label: G
options.text: It would raise awareness of GreenShields, which would cause other students to design energy-efficient products.

options.label: H
options.text: It would show that Jonny’s design is helpful, which would help him win public support.

options.label: J
options.text: It would encourage students to ride school buses, which would lead to fewer cars on the road.
